page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Running head at top, page number at top right. Two marginal notes in the right margin, beside the lower lines. Signature and catchword at the foot.

page.notes: Two marginal notes in the right margin: "Greg. lib. 4" (mark k, beside "Dum") and the bare reference "Epist. 36." beside the line "Quam-diu". Mark k is printed as a superscript in the text. Uncertain readings: "ardinis" (possibly "ordinis") and "feruemus" (possibly "seruemus"), both marked [?]. The "Cap.6." in the running head is copied as printed. Italic and roman runs in the lines were judged from the scan and may be imperfect. Hyphenated line-end words are kept with their printed hyphens.
